name: 07067 · Colonia, NJ
findings: ZIP 07067 (Colonia) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07067 (Colonia) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
